authorial_liberties.scope: The Janitor Cart Interrogation & Tendril Severing
authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Streamlined circular table debate into sharp, adversarial interrogation in the campus quad.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Focalized directly on the captive Gorgon minion in the mobile trash bin, heightening Alfie's swift tendril strike and the erupting purple beacon flare.
authorial_liberties.cut_rationale: Tightened procedural hesitation to escalate dramatic urgency.

authorial_liberties.scope: The Campus Flight & The Redactor Stalker
authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Condensed the retreat across the lawn into a taut sensory pursuit against the six-fingered, multi-faced inky entity.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Staged Pierre's rabbit patronus conjuration as a desperate rear-guard distraction as Eusacles shoulders Alfie into the Lost Roads.
authorial_liberties.cut_rationale: Paced the creature's eerie pursuit to establish immediate visceral terror.

authorial_liberties.scope: The Lost Roads & The Angel of the Natural History Museum
authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Fused wandering through the interstitial fog into Susanna's sudden emergence from the undergrowth.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Heightened Pierre's theatrical charm and flirtatious bravado against Susanna's bewildered survival, anchoring their discovery of the wild berry thicket.
authorial_liberties.cut_rationale: Smooths navigation banter into a lively character dynamic.

authorial_liberties.scope: Arrival at the Margin & The Mended Spatula
authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Accelerated the dawn transition from the overgrown road trail to the cedar porch of the Margin.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Turned Eusacles' Mending spell on Pierre's broken javelin-spatula into an instant culinary triumph with Mike before Teddy's somber debrief on the second fragment.
authorial_liberties.cut_rationale: Contrasts domestic camp comedy with the escalating stakes of being hunted.

authorial_liberties.scope: Rum Pancakes, Alfie's Threads & The Hermes Monopoly
authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Distilled the camp breakfast into a rich exploration of Alfie's mythic consciousness (458 years of thread memories vs. four days of living flesh).
authorial_liberties.reordering: Juxtaposed Alfie's boisterous intoxication against Rosa's gentle trauma inquiry and Teddy's account of the Hermes Express extortion.
authorial_liberties.cut_rationale: Deepens party bonding and cosmological worldbuilding without conversational drag.

authorial_liberties.scope: Campfire Vigil & The Dream of Thanatos
authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Condensed the perimeter watch into Eusacles' nocturnal communion in his timber cabin.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Dramatized the sudden visitation of Thanatos, framing the god of natural death's bureaucratic distance and the watch engraving with mythic intimacy.
authorial_liberties.cut_rationale: Elevates demigod parental tension into an ominous divine covenant.

authorial_liberties.scope: Bootleg Cinema & The Divine Flavor Duel
authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Streamlined the morning breakfast preamble into Pierre's furious culinary defense when Eusacles enchants the pancakes.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Staged the impromptu spear thrust and Cure Wounds stitching as dark slapstick that immediately cuts to Naomi's dramatic arrival.
authorial_liberties.cut_rationale: Maintains rapid kinetic tempo leading into the new investigation.

authorial_liberties.scope: Naomi's True-Crime Lead & The Utopian Master
authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Fused the podcast audio breakdown into an intense ideological debate over the Master's historical surgery.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Pitted Pierre's critique of utopian micro-edits against Alfie's Horcrux analogy, establishing the party's status as living anomaly anchors.
authorial_liberties.cut_rationale: Sharpens tactical stakes and philosophical divisions among the companions.

authorial_liberties.scope: The Mother of Monsters & The Watch Deflection
authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Condensed pre-departure preparations into Pierre's intimidation clarification regarding his fearsome Italian matriarch.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Concluded with the reflex test where Eusacles' engraved watch cleanly repels Pierre's spear strike, flowing into the push-up montage before Washington DC.
authorial_liberties.cut_rationale: Delivers an energetic, grounded cliffhanger closing Act II.
